verdict.rationale: Bun's package manager is explicitly built as a drop-in replacement using familiar npm-style commands (bun install, bun add, bun remove, bun update, bunx) and automatically migrates existing npm/yarn/pnpm lockfiles, requiring no changes to package.json. Community confirms it can be adopted as 'package manager only' without switching runtimes, easing incumbent-tool migration, though some report install bugs when switching between lockfile ecosystems (bun-comm-7) and unresolved questions about monorepo edge cases (bun-comm-10). Missing for 10: independent benchmark/testimony confirming 1:1 command parity across all npm/yarn/pnpm subcommands and resolution of the reported install glitches.
